summary: Implementation-ready backlog for Antigravity API Gateway concurrency, correctness, and deployment hardening. Implementation is not started; this document establishes requirements, packages, tests, and boundaries.
authorizationBoundaries: No application runtime code, config, or tests are modified during the planning phase.
Local implementation of packages WP-01 through WP-12 proceeds under standard local test development without live API calls.
Live provider qualification and load benchmarking (WP-13) strictly require explicit user authorization, specified cost/request ceilings, and monitored account error thresholds.
Client configuration adjustments in OpenCode or Hermes (WP-14) require explicit user consent and backup confirmation prior to editing.
Remote VPS deployment, DNS configuration, and account secret transfer (WP-15, WP-16) strictly require explicit user consent and private pre-provisioning.
definitionOfDone: Every work package must have automated deterministic unit/integration tests running under node --test.
No test may bypass authentication or mock away the core bug without testing the real code path.
Zero regressions across the existing 14 console security and authentication test suites.
Source files must maintain clean linting and strict non-root Linux container compatibility.
All private credentials (tokens, secrets, sessions) must remain strictly redacted and excluded from git and docker layers.

milestones.title: Protocol & Stream Reliability Core
exitCriteria: Stream replay bug eliminated with automated proof of single downstream generation.
Tool call streaming emits finish_reason 'tool_calls' consistently.
Framing-aware SSE parser correctly handles EOF and chunk boundaries.
Canonical model resolution unified across admission, routes, and rate-limits.
Disabled accounts and unexpired cooldowns strictly honored.

milestones.title: Auth Concurrency & Storage Integrity
exitCriteria: OAuth refresh is single-flight per account under concurrent requests.
Rate limit parser reliably handles Google ms, s, and header timestamps.
Serialized atomic state saves prevent race conditions and reload accurately reflects disk.

milestones.title: High-Concurrency Scheduler & Admission Queue
exitCriteria: Atomic attempt leases reserve accounts before async work with 100% cleanup.
Bounded admission queue enforces byte/request limits and cancellation pruning.
Accurate usage metrics and structured telemetry exposed without sensitive leaks.
Model fallback remains strictly opt-in with explicit capability compatibility checks.

milestones.title: Empirical Qualification & Production Deployment
exitCriteria: Controlled live benchmark measures true throughput and latency percentiles.
OpenCode and Hermes clients verified against actual gateway reasoning payloads.
Pre-provisioned single-owner bootstrap enforced before public container startup.
Remote Caddy HTTPS proxy verified with end-to-end streaming flush.

requirements.title: Eliminate Stream Replay and Double Generation
requirements.description: Ensure that once downstream streaming has commenced, an upstream error terminates the stream with an error event rather than retrying and interleaving a second generation.
acceptance: No stream may yield more than one message_start event under upstream retry scenarios.
Downstream commitment flag prevents failover loops once content has flushed.

requirements.title: Preserve Tool Call Finish Reason in SSE
requirements.description: Fix OpenAI streaming conversion so that tool calls result in finish_reason 'tool_calls' instead of 'stop' when upstream Google CloudCode returns STOP.
acceptance: When parts contain functionCall, finish_reason must be 'tool_calls' across all stream chunks.
Tool call parameters and IDs must match non-streaming behavior.

requirements.title: Framing-Aware SSE Parsing and Truncation Detection
requirements.description: Replace simple newline splitting with framing-aware parsing, handling buffer flushes, UTF-8 boundaries, and treating truncated responses as explicit errors rather than empty success.
acceptance: Incomplete SSE buffers at EOF fail closed with stream truncation error.
Empty streams do not emit placeholder success text.

requirements.title: Unified Model Resolution and Cooldown Scoping
requirements.description: Resolve model aliases to canonical IDs at entry point, ensuring rate limit lookups, admission checks, and request conversion use identical identifiers.
acceptance: Model aliases like gemini-3.8-flash map to gemini-3.8-flash-tiered before rate-limit checks.
Rate limits recorded under canonical IDs are recognized on alias requests.

requirements.title: Strict Account Eligibility and Cooldown Preservation
requirements.description: Ensure accounts marked enabled: false are excluded from selection, and remove route-level blanket resets that wipe unexpired cooldowns.
acceptance: Disabled accounts (enabled: false) are never selected by pickStickyAccount or pickNext.
Inference requests never call resetAllRateLimits on unexpired cooldowns.

requirements.title: Single-Flight Token Refresh and 401 Re-acquisition
requirements.description: Deduplicate concurrent token refresh calls per account, and ensure post-401 retries re-acquire fresh credentials before attempting subsequent endpoints.
acceptance: Concurrent credential calls for the same account trigger exactly one OAuth refresh request.
401 retry loop fetches a fresh token before attempting the fallback endpoint.

requirements.title: Robust Quota Reset Delay and Timestamp Parsing
requirements.description: Fix regex patterns for quotaResetDelay (seconds and milliseconds) and headers to compute accurate backoff durations.
acceptance: Decimal seconds ('1.5s') parse accurately to 1500ms without fallback truncation.
Millisecond durations ('754.43ms') parse correctly to integer milliseconds.

requirements.title: Serialized Account State Persistence and Dynamic Reload
requirements.description: Serialize and debounce account updates to disk, prevent concurrent file corruption, and ensure the reload endpoint properly refreshes in-memory state.
acceptance: Overlapping save operations queue sequentially using atomic temp files.
POST /v1/accounts/reload completely refreshes accounts from disk.

requirements.title: Atomic Account Lease with Bounded Concurrency
requirements.description: Implement an atomic select-and-reserve attempt lease mechanism tracking active in-flight requests per account and releasing reliably in finally blocks.
acceptance: Accounts are reserved synchronously before async work, preventing overbooking.
Leases are idempotently released on success, error, cancellation, and disconnect.

requirements.title: Bounded Fair Admission Queue with Cancellation Pruning
requirements.description: Implement an in-memory queue with max request count and byte limits, fair scheduling across API keys, and immediate removal on client disconnect.
acceptance: Excess requests beyond queue capacity receive HTTP 429 with explicit Retry-After.
Client abort signals immediately dequeue waiting requests without orphan processing.

requirements.title: Structured Request Telemetry and Token Usage Accounting
requirements.description: Provide detailed logging of queue delays, lease durations, TTFT, model IDs, and correct streamed token usage (prompt + candidate tokens).
acceptance: Streamed OpenAI usage includes accurate prompt_tokens and completion_tokens.
Logs record request performance metrics without leaking keys, tokens, or prompt bodies.

requirements.title: Opt-In Fallback and Capability-Aware Request Translation
requirements.description: Keep model fallback strictly opt-in, validate model transitions against supported capabilities, and accurately translate thinking parameters and output token caps.
acceptance: Model fallback is disabled by default; when enabled, only pre-approved compatible models are used.
Gemini output token limits and reasoning budgets match validated upstream specifications.

requirements.title: Empirical Concurrency Benchmarking under Real Quotas
requirements.description: Design an authorized, controlled benchmark protocol measuring p50/p95 latency and sustainable RPM under varying concurrent agent counts.
acceptance: Benchmark measures actual task completion and tool turns, not just raw ping latency.
Explicit stopping criteria prevent quota burn or account suspensions.

requirements.title: Client Compatibility Verification (OpenCode and Hermes)
requirements.description: Verify that OpenCode and Hermes properly serialize reasoning parameters and display streamed thinking without truncation or tool errors.
acceptance: OpenCode private-gateway provider successfully executes multi-turn tool sessions.
Hermes custom provider correctly captures and formats reasoning_content.

requirements.title: Enforced Pre-Provisioned Single-Owner Bootstrap
requirements.description: Require owner credentials to be pre-created in private storage before allowing public internet exposure, preventing first-visitor takeover.
acceptance: Container startup fails closed if exposed to public origin without configured owner.
start-vps.sh removes obsolete setup-token references and enforces private data init.

requirements.title: Production Caddy Reverse Proxy and Network Topology
requirements.description: Deploy Docker Compose stack with non-root gateway container and Caddy reverse proxy using internal service networking and unbuffered SSE flush.
acceptance: Caddyfile proxies directly to antigravity-gateway:8080 with flush_interval -1.
Gateway loopback port binding prevents direct internet exposure of unproxied ports.

workPackages.title: Stream Replay Elimination & Downstream Commitment Guard
workPackages.goal: Prevent stream handlers from restarting or switching endpoints once partial output has been yielded to the client.
acceptance: Streaming handler tracks downstream commitment and raises terminal error on failure after first yield.
Unit tests prove that upstream error after partial yield produces error event, never second message_start.
workPackages.evidence: tests/unit/streaming-handler.test.mjs passing with simulated interrupted stream

workPackages.title: Streamed Tool Calls Finish Reason Alignment
workPackages.goal: Ensure functionCall blocks in streaming responses result in finish_reason 'tool_calls' rather than 'stop'.
acceptance: When candidate contains functionCall, stopReason in sse-streamer remains 'tool_use' even if finishReason is STOP.
convertAnthropicEventToOpenAI translates tool_use stop_reason to finish_reason: 'tool_calls'.

workPackages.title: Framing-Aware SSE Parser & Truncation Guard
workPackages.goal: Implement robust SSE framing parser that handles chunk boundaries, UTF-8 splits, and rejects truncated EOFs.
acceptance: Unterminated SSE frames at EOF trigger explicit StreamTruncatedError instead of synthetic empty message.
Decoder correctly buffers multi-byte UTF-8 sequences split across raw stream chunks.
workPackages.evidence: tests/unit/sse-framing.test.mjs passing all edge cases including split chunks and abrupt EOF

workPackages.title: Canonical Model Identity & Cooldown Scoping
workPackages.goal: Ensure all routes, rate-limit checkers, and request converters use canonical model IDs consistently.
acceptance: resolveModel is applied at the entry point of /v1/chat/completions, /v1/responses, and /v1/messages.
Rate limits recorded against canonical models are properly checked when requests use aliases.
workPackages.evidence: tests/unit/model-canonical.test.mjs proving alias requests observe canonical rate limits

workPackages.title: Strict Account Eligibility & Route Cooldown Preservation
workPackages.goal: Prevent selection of disabled accounts and remove reckless blanket rate-limit resets in route handlers.
acceptance: isAccountUsable and getAvailableAccounts explicitly filter out accounts where enabled === false.
Removed resetAllRateLimits calls on incoming requests in src/server.js lines 631, 776, 860.
workPackages.evidence: tests/unit/eligibility.test.mjs verifying disabled accounts are never routed and unexpired cooldowns survive

workPackages.title: Single-Flight Token Refresh & Post-401 Re-acquisition
workPackages.goal: Deduplicate concurrent refresh requests per account and refresh token prior to second-endpoint retry.
acceptance: Concurrent calls to getTokenForAccount share a single pending Promise, preventing token refresh storms.
Upon 401 response, cache is cleared and fresh token is fetched before trying the next fallback endpoint.
workPackages.evidence: tests/unit/auth-singleflight.test.mjs confirming single refresh execution under concurrent load

workPackages.title: Quota Reset Delay & Error Duration Parser Hardening
workPackages.goal: Fix regexes and parsing logic for quotaResetDelay, Retry-After, and ISO timestamps.
acceptance: quotaResetDelay regex properly extracts decimal seconds (1.5s -> 1500ms) and milliseconds (750ms -> 750ms).
Parser returns valid finite millisecond delay or null, logging anomalies clearly.
workPackages.evidence: tests/unit/rate-limit-parser.test.mjs validating diverse header and error string payloads

workPackages.title: Serialized Account State Persistence & Dynamic Reload
workPackages.goal: Serialize account writes using an in-memory queue and ensure reload endpoint completely refreshes state.
acceptance: Concurrent saveAccounts calls execute sequentially via Promise chain with atomic file replacement.
POST /v1/accounts/reload resets initialized flag and re-reads config from disk without server restart.
workPackages.evidence: tests/unit/storage-concurrency.test.mjs proving zero corrupt writes under rapid save cycles

workPackages.title: Atomic Account Lease Engine (Select-and-Reserve)
workPackages.goal: Implement in-flight connection tracking with atomic reservation and guaranteed lease release.
acceptance: Acquires attempt lease synchronously during selection, incrementing account inFlightCount.
Lease object exposes release() method guaranteed to be idempotent and decrement count exactly once.
workPackages.evidence: tests/unit/lease-engine.test.mjs verifying count never leaks or goes negative under simulated failure

workPackages.title: Bounded Fair Admission Queue & Cancellation Pruning
workPackages.goal: Implement an in-memory queue to absorb temporary traffic spikes with byte limits and client abort handling.
acceptance: Queue rejects requests exceeding max_queue_depth or max_queue_bytes with HTTP 429 and Retry-After.
When client disconnects or AbortSignal triggers, pending queue entries are immediately pruned.
workPackages.evidence: tests/unit/admission-queue.test.mjs testing overflow rejection and disconnect pruning

workPackages.title: Telemetry & Accurate Streamed Token Usage Accounting
workPackages.goal: Record per-request queue delays, lease durations, and repair prompt_tokens calculation in SSE events.
acceptance: Streamed usage block reflects promptTokenCount and candidatesTokenCount accurately from Google metadata.
Structured log events record queue time, execution duration, and account index without leaking prompts or keys.
workPackages.evidence: tests/unit/telemetry.test.mjs verifying usage fields and safe logging format

workPackages.title: Capability-Aware Request Mapping & Opt-In Fallback
workPackages.goal: Enforce strict opt-in model fallback, validate model capabilities, and fix thinking/output parameter mapping.
acceptance: Model fallback remains disabled by default; only explicitly configured compatible chains are executed.
reasoning_effort and thinkingLevel serialize accurately to Google thinkingConfig with proper output token headroom.
workPackages.evidence: tests/unit/model-capability.test.mjs verifying output caps, thinking budgets, and strict opt-in fallback

workPackages.title: Controlled Canary Load Benchmark & Capacity Qualification
workPackages.goal: Conduct a separately authorized, small-scale live benchmark to measure actual RPM and latency under real quotas.
acceptance: Runs only after user approves concurrency levels and cost/token ceilings.
Measures p50/p95 TTFT, queue duration, and error rates across 1 to 6 concurrent agents, stopping on consecutive 429s.
workPackages.evidence: docs/BENCHMARK_RESULTS.md containing measured data points, sample sizes, and error distributions

workPackages.title: Client Integration & Thinking Profile Validation
workPackages.goal: Validate end-to-end tool execution and reasoning stream rendering in OpenCode and Hermes.
acceptance: Hermes CLI executes multi-turn tool call session with reasoning rendered cleanly.
OpenCode private-gateway provider executes file edits and terminal tasks without thinking schema errors.
workPackages.evidence: Verified transcript of harmless tool execution turn with reasoning content captured

workPackages.title: Pre-Provisioned Owner Bootstrap & Packaging Hardening
workPackages.goal: Enforce private owner setup prior to public start and reconcile start-vps.sh instructions.
acceptance: start-vps.sh validates existing access.json owner before launching public Docker stack.
Removed stale data/console/setup-token references from deployment scripts.
workPackages.evidence: tests/console/deployment.test.mjs confirming startup fails closed if owner is unconfigured in production

workPackages.title: Production Caddy Reverse Proxy & Service Networking
workPackages.goal: Configure production Docker Compose stack with internal Caddy service networking and unbuffered SSE.
acceptance: Caddy reverse proxies to antigravity-gateway:8080 with flush_interval -1.
Gateway container binds 0.0.0.0 internally and only loopback port on host, ensuring all external traffic passes through Caddy.
workPackages.evidence: Validated compose configuration and verified remote HTTPS header flush
